name: Tsuzuki Haruka
source: One of the most popular girls in the school and also the protagonist's kouhai, she's suffering from some illness. Friendly and affectionate, popular among boys. For that reason, girls are a bit jealous. Actually, she's a liar and finds joy in cheating people and manipulating them. The whole illness story is also a lie, she feels herself perfectly fine. But what's the reason for all this lie..?
